notes: Where-you-work picker (Paycheck tab): Walmart Digital Personal Shopper, Target, Amazon warehouse, McDonald's, or Custom — one tap sets your rate. Presets are starting points; the rate stays editable.

NEW Stocks tab (educational): watchlist with prices you type in yourself, price-history charts with highs and lows, an allocation calculator against your savings, and beginner investing videos. Paper-trading only — nothing moves real money, and this is not financial advice.
Device sync code (My Money tab): generate a one-time code on your phone, paste it on your PC, and everything moves over. No server, no account — copy/paste it yourself.

Deal Watchlist upgrade: store presets (Best Buy, Walmart, Amazon, Target, Newegg), per-item price history with a mini highs/lows chart, and a target-hit alert when the price you see hits your buy price.
Donut chart: tap any slice to see its category, amount, and share of the total; the center number pops up or down as your numbers change.
Fixed empty states: the goal celebration only fires when you set a real goal and reach it; with no income entered, the budget says so plainly instead of showing a $0.00 math chain.
New responsive layout: phones keep the single-column stacked cards with the bottom tab bar; PCs get a multi-column dashboard.
